lesson_text: L27_Price_Level standalone (Hwang & Lu 2007) fails completely in Korea: SR 0.505, CAGR 13.5%, MDD 62.7%, Score 0.0. The price level anomaly documented in US markets does not transfer to KOSPI. Low-price-stock premium is likely absorbed by Korea's different market microstructure (daily price limits, retail dominance). Factor is dead — no S5 value.
core_reference: Hwang & Lu (2007) JFM price level effect. L27_Price_Level from Factor DB. Confirms L-395/L-396 pattern of traditional price-based factor failure in Korea.
